localized_content.title: Maha Bharani
localized_content.short_answer: First resolve your city, Bharani Nakshatra during the relevant Pitru Paksha aparahna, and your family's current authority: a Delhi 2027 fixture says 20 September while a US fixture says 19 September. significance.text: Maha Bharani is a named Pitru Paksha ancestor-remembrance day selected by Bharani Nakshatra in the relevant aparahna, not by one fixed tithi or national civil date. origin_narratives.title: Nachiketa asks Yama about death
origin_narratives.summary: In Max Muller's 1884 Katha Upanishad, Vajasravasa gives worn-out cows in sacrifice. His young son Nachiketa repeatedly asks to whom he will be given; his angry father says, ‘to Death.’ Nachiketa reaches Yama's abode and waits three nights while Yama is away. Yama returns and grants three boons: Nachiketa first asks to be welcomed calmly by his father, then learns the fire teaching, and finally asks what follows death. Yama offers long life, descendants, wealth, power, music and pleasure instead, but Nachiketa rejects what is temporary. Yama distinguishes the good from the merely pleasant and teaches about Self, knowledge and death; the text closes with Nachiketa attaining that teaching's goal. This child danger, waiting, reconciliation and fire must never be copied. The story neither proves an afterlife fact nor supplies Maha Bharani's origin, formal vidhi or an ancestor message.

steps.instruction: Resolve the city, civil date, Bharani Nakshatra interval, relevant aparahna and accepted Panchang. If unresolved, do not declare today Maha Bharani.

steps.instruction: Ask whether a named family elder, priest, sampradaya or institution says Maha Bharani applies to this ancestor and who may perform a formal rite. If unknown, stay with this private route.

steps.instruction: Keep normal food, water, medicine, sleep and care. Sit somewhere private and safe; no fast, bath, flame, travel, donation or purchase is needed.

steps.instruction: Hear the calendrical identity and the complete source-labelled Nachiketa-Yama story, including its child-danger and afterlife boundaries.

steps.instruction: Remember the deceased by a name, one value, one safe memory or silence. Do not interpret dreams, birds, flames, food, coincidence or feeling as a message.

steps.instruction: Optionally choose one small, safe living-care act already within your role, or choose none; do not promise forgiveness, reconciliation, donation or family disclosure.

steps.instruction: Close with normal food, water, medicine and rest. Claim no liberation, merit-equivalence, curse removal, prosperity, forgiveness or ritual score.

closing.text: Return to ordinary care. Memory, silence and no action are all acceptable; later events are not ancestor messages or a ritual score.

localized_content.short_answer: पहले अपना शहर, Pitru Paksha के सम्बद्ध अपराह्न में भरणी नक्षत्र और family की current authority तय करें: Delhi 2027 fixture 20 September कहता है, US fixture 19 September। Formal applicability या performer eligibility न मिले तो पूर्ण private remembrance route लें—सामान्य care, दो labelled stories, एक सुरक्षित स्मृति या मौन, optional living care, और कोई गढ़ी हुई Shraddha procedure या result claim नहीं।

origin_narratives.title: नचिकेता यम से मृत्यु के बारे में पूछते हैं
origin_narratives.summary: Max Muller की 1884 Katha Upanishad में Vajasravasa यज्ञ में बूढ़ी, क्षीण गायें देते हैं। उनके छोटे पुत्र Nachiketa बार-बार पूछते हैं कि उन्हें किसे दिया जाएगा; क्रोध में पिता कहते हैं, ‘मृत्यु को।’ Nachiketa Yama के घर पहुँचकर उनकी अनुपस्थिति में तीन रात प्रतीक्षा करते हैं। लौटकर Yama तीन वर देते हैं: Nachiketa पहले पिता से शांत स्वागत, फिर अग्नि-विद्या और अंत में मृत्यु के बाद क्या होता है यह पूछते हैं। Yama बदले में long life, descendants, wealth, power, music और pleasure देते हैं, पर Nachiketa temporary वस्तुएँ अस्वीकार करते हैं। Yama good और merely pleasant का अंतर तथा Self, knowledge और death की शिक्षा देते हैं; text Nachiketa के उस teaching-goal को पाने पर बंद होता है। Child danger, waiting, reconciliation और fire कभी copy न हों। कथा afterlife fact सिद्ध नहीं करती और Maha Bharani origin, formal vidhi या ancestor message नहीं देती।

steps.instruction: इच्छुक participants को धन्यवाद देकर privacy रखें; relatives को rank, future duty assign, omen-read या completion judge किए बिना बंद करें।
steps.why: कोई family member ritual judge या messenger नहीं बनता।

closing.text: Privacy रखें, सामान्य care पर लौटें और formal questions नामित वर्तमान authority को दें।
closing.scope_note: सहमति-आधारित पारिवारिक स्मरण synthesis; पुरोहित, therapist, succession authority, afterlife interpreter या formal Shraddha owner नहीं।

procedures.label: नामित औपचारिक श्राद्ध या संस्था: केवल participant route
procedures.authority_scope: केवल visitor/participant guidance। नामित वर्तमान family, priest, sampradaya, temple, Gaya या ghat authority eligibility, performer, timing, sequence, materials और closing की owner है।

substitutions: उत्तर न मिले तो न जाएँ

materials.item: केवल वही सामग्री जो authority स्पष्ट रूप से कहे

steps.instruction: नामित current authority पहचानकर city, date, Bharani/aparahna rule, ancestor applicability, performer eligibility, venue और live schedule verify करें।
steps.why: Search result या generic pack formal decisions नहीं कर सकता।

steps.instruction: पूछें participant क्या कर और ला सकता है; इस pack से पिंड, तिल, कुश, अग्नि, vessels, offerings, dress या dakshina list न बनाएँ।
steps.why: Formal material list owner route की है।

steps.instruction: Accessibility, crowd, water, fire, smoke, food, medicine, child/dependent, travel, privacy और cost conditions देखें; unsafe हो तो मना करें या निकलें।
steps.why: Institutional participation safety या consent से ऊपर नहीं।

steps.instruction: Law, consent, health और budget के भीतर staff/family directions मानें; permission बिना lead, film, touch, restricted space में entry या procedure home-copy न करें।
steps.why: Participation officiation या transmission authority नहीं है।

steps.instruction: Merit, Gaya-equivalence, liberation, forgiveness और afterlife language को attributed tradition claim मानें, Devam guarantee या ancestor message नहीं।
steps.why: Living claims source-labelled और bounded रहते हैं।

steps.instruction: Authority की safe closing लें, belongings लें, खाएँ, पानी/दवा लें और omen-reading या donation, reconciliation, return-pressure के बिना निकलें।
steps.why: Participant route ordinary care और free consent में समाप्त होता है।

closing.text: केवल नामित authority की safe closing लें, फिर prediction, debt या copied formal procedure के बिना सामान्य care पर लौटें।
closing.scope_note: केवल visitor/participant guidance। नामित वर्तमान family, priest, sampradaya, temple, Gaya या ghat authority eligibility, performer, timing, sequence, materials और closing की owner है।

variants.scope: Selected North/West और named shared states
variants.difference: Language, spelling, dress, food preference, familiar prayer, photograph/no-photograph और silence minor हैं; state procedures नहीं बनते।
Current practitioner material दोनों limits बताता है; applicable route केवल named family या textual authority तय करे।
ये rules formal rite और leader तय करते हैं; gender, kinship या calendar label से अनुमान नहीं होता।

variants.scope: Named family, priest, sampradaya, temple, Gaya या ghat procedure
variants.difference: Timing, sequence, mantra, materials, fire/water conditions, payment और closing current owner के हैं।

variants.scope: Ordinary tithi Shraddha, Magha Shraddha या Sarva Pitru Amavasya
variants.difference: Selection rules और applicability अलग हैं; ये Maha Bharani के aliases या fallback procedures नहीं।
यह अलग temple-festival identity है; ancestor-remembrance Maha Bharani से derive या merge न करें।

variants.scope: Grief, abuse, estrangement, child/dependent, food, medicine, water, fire, crowd, accessibility, privacy या financial risk
variants.difference: Safety और consent participation को बदल या रोक सकते हैं और ritual completion से हमेशा ऊपर हैं।

safety_and_boundaries: Fast, dehydration, meal delay, medicine change, ritual bath, water entry, fire, smoke, crowd, travel, animal feeding, food disposal, donation या priest payment आवश्यक नहीं।
कोई child/dependent Nachiketa का departure, danger, fasting, waiting, abusive command मानना, unsafe reconciliation या fire copy न करे; guardian safety story से ऊपर है।
किसी पर forgiveness, reconciliation, belief, touch, photograph, family disclosure या public grief का कर्ज़ नहीं; abuse और estrangement spiritual failure नहीं।
Dreams, birds, food, flame, coincidence और feelings को ancestor messages न मानें। Liberation, Gaya-equivalent merit, curse removal, forgiveness, prosperity या reunion का promise नहीं।
Widow, widower, daughter, son, childless, unmarried, adopted, estranged या non-participant व्यक्ति को shame या automatic duty assign न करें।
Formal Shraddha materials/actions इस pack से reconstruct न करें; named current authority लें या private remembrance पर रहें।
Immediate danger में 112 लें। Medical, fire, water, grief-crisis, safeguarding और institutional rules ritual completion से ऊपर हैं।
Authored का अर्थ केवल यह lane pack है; projected, hosted, independently released या published नहीं।

open_gaps: Not projected, hosted or published; named formal Shraddha procedures remain separate owner lanes.
